tab.label: Email
tab.title: Email
tab.intro: LibreFolio can send emails through an SMTP server, set up by whoever runs the instance. Email is optional: without it, everything else works.

off.explanation: No SMTP server is configured (LIBREFOLIO_SMTP_HOST), so nothing is sent: invitation and password-reset links are copied by hand. The guide explains how to set one up.

invalid.explanation: Email stays off until the configuration is fixed: correct the variable, then restart LibreFolio.

problems.SMTP_HOST_INVALID: {variable} is not a valid server name: write only the host name or the IP address, without scheme, port or path.
problems.SMTP_TLS_INVALID: {variable} must be starttls, tls or none.
problems.SMTP_PORT_INVALID: {variable} must be a whole number from 1 to 65535.
problems.SMTP_FROM_MISSING: {variable} is missing: the sender address is required.
problems.SMTP_FROM_INVALID: {variable} must be one address, such as noreply@example.com, optionally after a name, with the address in angle brackets.
problems.SMTP_MAX_PER_HOUR_INVALID: {variable} must be a whole number of at least 1.
problems.SMTP_PASSWORD_UNREADABLE: The password file named by {variable} cannot be read.
problems.SMTP_CREDENTIALS_INCOMPLETE: {variable} is set alone: set both the SMTP user and its password, or neither.

smtp.off: Email is off: no SMTP server is configured.
smtp.ok: The SMTP configuration can be used.
smtp.invalid: {variable} cannot be used ({problem}): email stays off until it is fixed.

smtpEncryption.ok: Emails travel encrypted, or email is off.
smtpEncryption.localPlain: Emails go unencrypted to a server of the local network.
smtpEncryption.plain: Emails, their links and the SMTP password travel unencrypted to a server outside the local network: set LIBREFOLIO_SMTP_TLS to starttls or tls.

links.ok: Emails can carry links: LIBREFOLIO_PUBLIC_URL is set, or email is off.
links.missing: LIBREFOLIO_PUBLIC_URL is not set: emails work, but none with a link (forgotten password, invitation, reset) can go out.
links.invalid: LIBREFOLIO_PUBLIC_URL cannot start a link: it needs http:// or https:// and a host name, with no user name, password, ? or #. No email with a link can go out.

probe.checking: Checking from this device that this instance answers there…
probe.match: This instance answers there, from this device.
probe.otherInstance: From this device, another server answers at that address, not this instance. This check covers this device only: the cause may be its DNS or its network. If other devices see the same, the links in emails lead elsewhere: check LIBREFOLIO_PUBLIC_URL.
probe.unreachable: This device cannot reach this instance at that address. This check covers this device only: the cause may be its DNS or its network. If other devices cannot either, the links in emails will not open: check LIBREFOLIO_PUBLIC_URL.
probe.insecure: This page uses https:// while LIBREFOLIO_PUBLIC_URL starts with http://: this browser cannot check it, and the links in emails would travel unencrypted. Set it to the https:// address.
probe.invalid: This browser cannot read LIBREFOLIO_PUBLIC_URL as an address: the links in emails may not open. Check its value.

budget.spent: The hourly limit of {max} emails is reached: the next one can go in {minutes} min.

test.hint: Send a test email to your own address to check the configuration.
test.sent: Test email sent to your address: check your inbox, and the spam folder.

errors.EMAIL_UNAVAILABLE: Email is off or not working on this instance.
errors.EMAIL_RATE_LIMITED: The hourly email limit is reached: try again in {minutes} min.
errors.EMAIL_RECIPIENT_INVALID: The address of your account is not a valid email address.
errors.generic: The test email could not be sent.

smtpErrors.CONNECTION_FAILED: LibreFolio cannot reach the SMTP server: check the host and the port.
smtpErrors.TLS_FAILED: The secure connection failed: check LIBREFOLIO_SMTP_TLS and the certificate of the server.
smtpErrors.AUTH_FAILED: The SMTP server refused the login: check the user and the password.
smtpErrors.SENDER_REFUSED: The SMTP server refused the sender address (LIBREFOLIO_SMTP_FROM).
smtpErrors.RECIPIENT_REFUSED: The SMTP server refused your address.
smtpErrors.TIMEOUT: The SMTP server did not answer in time.
smtpErrors.SEND_FAILED: The SMTP server did not take the message.

email.loadError: The state of email could not be read.

page.expired: This link has expired. Sign in with your username and password: you will be offered a new link.
page.consumed: This link has already been used. If your account is active, sign in.
page.revoked: This link no longer works: sign in to ask for a new one.
page.unknown: This link is not valid: open it again, whole, from the email. If it still fails, sign in to ask for a new one.
page.blocked: This instance is blocked by its hosting provider, so the link cannot be checked now. Open it again once the instance is unblocked; if the link has expired by then, sign in to get a new one.
page.missing: This link is incomplete: open it again from the email.
page.error: The link could not be checked: try again.

verification.verified: Your email address is verified, {username}: you can sign in.
verification.loginRequired: Your email address is not verified yet: open the link in the email we sent you, then sign in.
verification.resent: A new link is on its way: check your inbox, and the spam folder. Older links no longer work.

resendErrors.INVALID_CREDENTIALS: The username or the password is not right: check them in the form above.
resendErrors.EMAIL_RATE_LIMITED: Too many requests for now: try again in {minutes} min.
resendErrors.EMAIL_VERIFICATION_NOT_NEEDED: Your account is already active: sign in.
resendErrors.USER_LIMIT_REACHED: Your link has expired, and this instance is full now: ask its administrator.
resendErrors.ACCOUNT_DISABLED: This account is disabled: ask the administrator of this instance.
resendErrors.unavailable: The email cannot be sent right now: try again later, or ask the administrator of this instance.
resendErrors.generic: The link could not be sent: try again.

verification.registered: Account created. We sent you an email with a link to activate it: open it within 24 hours, then sign in.
verification.signUpUnavailable: Sign-up is not possible right now: this instance cannot send the verification email. Try again later, or ask its administrator.
verification.settingNeedsEmail: Needs an email with a link to go out: set up SMTP and LIBREFOLIO_PUBLIC_URL first (Settings › Administration › Email).
verification.settingUnavailable: Email verification needs an email with a link to go out, and none can go now: check Settings › Administration › Email.

sendLink.resetTarget: The link goes to the email address of the account.
sendLink.publicUrlHint: The link in the email starts with the address set in LIBREFOLIO_PUBLIC_URL, which may differ from the one above.

errors.EMAIL_UNAVAILABLE: Email is off or not working on this instance.
errors.EMAIL_LINKS_UNAVAILABLE: Emails cannot carry links: LIBREFOLIO_PUBLIC_URL is not set, or cannot start a link.
errors.EMAIL_LINK_INVALID: This link no longer works: create a new one.
errors.EMAIL_ACCOUNT_INACTIVE: The account is not active: activate it before sending it a reset link.
errors.EMAIL_RECIPIENT_REQUIRED: Enter the address to send the invitation to.
errors.EMAIL_RECIPIENT_NOT_ALLOWED: A reset link goes only to the address of its account.
errors.EMAIL_RECIPIENT_INVALID: This is not one valid email address.
errors.EMAIL_RATE_LIMITED: The hourly email limit is reached: try again in {minutes} min.
errors.RECIPIENT_REFUSED: The SMTP server refused the recipient's address.
errors.generic: The email could not be sent.

forgot.label: Username or email address
forgot.accepted: If an active account matches, its owner gets an email with a link to choose a new password. Check the inbox and the spam folder: the link works for 30 minutes.

errors.unavailable: This instance cannot send emails right now: ask its administrator.
errors.EMAIL_RATE_LIMITED: Too many requests for now: try again in {minutes} min.
errors.generic: The request could not be sent: try again.
